Use GLM models in AutoClaw

AutoClaw brings GLM models into real workflows. It understands your goal, breaks down complex tasks, calls available tools, and delivers reusable results.

Model Updates

NEW 2026.08

GLM-5.3-Flash

Lightweight multimodal intelligence, built for speed

Capability

GLM-5.3-Flash is the first native multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, built for efficient coding and long-horizon Agent tasks. Its hybrid sparse and linear attention architecture preserves accurate long-context capabilities while significantly reducing compute overhead, outperforming GLM-5.2 across multiple benchmarks and real-world tasks. In AutoClaw, GLM-5.3-Flash is designed for frequent, lightweight tasks where timely feedback matters, keeping everyday work moving from understanding to delivery.

Best for

Image, screenshot, and visual-document understanding; Fast chart, file, and information processing; Documents, reports, and content workflows; Frequent, multi-step everyday tasks; Work that benefits from fast feedback and iteration

Tags
MultimodalLightweightFast responseEveryday workflows
2026.08

GLM-5.3

Keep the most complex work moving

Capability

GLM-5.3 is Z.AI's latest flagship model for complex engineering and long-horizon agent tasks. It goes beyond generating code—it can stay focused across large projects, manage multi-step dependencies, use tools, and adapt as the work progresses. In AutoClaw, GLM-5.3 is best suited to demanding tasks that require less manual breakdown and more end-to-end ownership, from understanding the problem to execution, validation, and delivery.

Best for

Complex software engineering; End-to-end product development; Large codebases and refactoring; Tool-heavy, multi-step workflows; Long-running research and technical tasks

Tags
Latest flagshipComplex engineeringLong-horizon tasksAgentic coding
2026.06

GLM-5.2

Stay grounded across larger projects

Capability

GLM-5.2 is designed for project-scale context and extended work. It can process large codebases, long documents, and tasks with substantial background information while retaining the details that matter. In AutoClaw, GLM-5.2 can work across your files and task history without requiring you to repeat the same context at every step. It is a strong fit for projects that involve ongoing analysis, revision, and validation.

Best for

Large projects and codebases; Long-document analysis; Deep research and synthesis; Multi-stage development work; Context-heavy workflows

Long contextLarge projectsContinuous collaborationProject delivery

GLM-5-Turbo is designed for complex workflows that involve multiple connected steps. It can stay aligned with the task, manage dependencies, and work with tools as the workflow progresses. 2026.04

GLM-5V-Turbo

Turn visual context into action

Capability

GLM-5V-Turbo brings visual understanding and visual coding to AutoClaw. It can interpret interfaces, screenshots, images, video, text, and files—not just written prompts. In AutoClaw, visual context can become the starting point for further work: analyzing a product screen, understanding a design, locating a UI issue, updating code, or producing a structured deliverable.

Best for

Screenshot and interface understanding; Design-to-code workflows; Document and chart analysis; Visual debugging; Multimodal agent workflows

Tags

Use Cases

Research and decision support

Research complex problems by finding, filtering, and synthesizing information across sources, comparing options and approaches, and delivering findings with clear conclusions and evidence.

Deliverables

Industry and competitor research; Company and product analysis; Market entry strategy; Policy and public information synthesis; Decision briefs and recommendations.

Documents and presentations

Turn existing files, meeting notes, and project materials into well-structured deliverables, organizing information, designing structure, and drafting and polishing content.

Deliverables

Business reports and project proposals; Word and PDF documents; Presentations and briefing materials; Meeting minutes and action lists; Multilingual and localized content.

Data analysis and reporting

Process spreadsheets, charts, and business data to find patterns, anomalies, and next-step suggestions.

Deliverables

Excel and CSV analysis; User and product behavior analysis; Operations metric reviews; Sales and market data summaries; Weekly and monthly reports and visualizations.

Operations and workflow automation

Handle repetitive multi-step daily work continuously, reducing manual information handoffs, duplicate effort, and repeated guidance.

Deliverables

Recurring business reports; Batch content organization; Project progress summaries; Website and content updates; Standard process execution results.

Visual understanding and content analysis

Understand screenshots, charts, scanned documents, interfaces, presentations, images, and video, and put visual information to work in downstream analysis and processing.

Deliverables

Chart and dashboard interpretation; PDF and scanned document summaries; Product interface review; Visual content extraction and organization; UI issue analysis and improvement suggestions.

Product and engineering

Understand product requirements and project files to drive implementation, debugging, testing, fixes, and technical documentation.

Deliverables

Product requirements breakdown; Website and app development; Code debugging and refactoring; Testing and bug fixes; Technical plans and engineering documentation.
